title: Green Dog in Surreal Desert
description: A close-up profile of a vibrant green dog with intricate maze and bone tattoos covering its head and neck. The background features a surreal desert landscape with sand dunes, a massive glowing green moon, and large red-and-white spotted mushrooms on an island.
